sites.name: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
sites.event: A place of detention and exile for loyal communist soldiers during the French colonial period (built in 1930), likened to 'hell on earth'.

sites.name: Lak Lake
sites.event: The largest natural freshwater lake in the Central Highlands and the second largest in Vietnam, associated with the villages of the M'nong people and the summer villa of King Bao Dai.

sites.name: Dray Nur Waterfall
sites.event: The most majestic waterfall in the Central Highlands, associated with the legend of a separated love between a young couple (Dray Nur means Female Waterfall).

sites.name: Buon Don (Ban Don)
sites.event: The legendary land of wild elephant hunting and taming, the homeland of Elephant King Khunjunob and the legend of Ama Kong.

sites.name: The World Coffee Museum
sites.event: A unique architectural work in the shape of a Central Highlands longhouse, displaying thousands of artifacts on the history and culture of global coffee.

sites.name: Mother Elephant Rock
sites.event: The largest monolith (granite) in Vietnam, shaped like a prostrate elephant in the middle of the mountains and forests.

sites.name: Sac Tu Khai Doan Pagoda
sites.event: The largest and oldest pagoda in Dak Lak, and the last pagoda in Vietnam to be granted royal patronage by the feudal regime (named after King Khai Dinh and Queen Mother Doan Huy).

sites.name: Yok Don National Park
sites.event: The only national park in Vietnam that conserves the characteristic dipterocarp forest ecosystem (open deciduous broadleaf forest in the dry season).

place.district: Buon Don District (and Ea Sup District)

sites.name: Buon Ako Dhong (Buon Co Thon)
sites.event: Known as the 'Village in the City', the most beautiful and wealthy village that preserves almost intact the traditional culture of the Ede people.

sites.name: Tomb of Elephant King Khunjunob
sites.event: A tomb complex with unique M'nong - Lao architecture, the resting place of the legendary elephant hunter Khunjunob (who hunted more than 400 elephants).

sites.name: Ancient Ko Nia Tree (Dak Lak Ko Nia Tree)
sites.event: A spiritual symbol of the Central Highlands ethnic people, associated with the famous song 'The Shadow of the Ko-nia Tree'.

place.hamlet: Backyard of the Central Cultural Center
